Generated: 2026-08-17T20:50:16.103Z

This report covers every currently generated 1:5 45 Trans source pattern: both Diamond and Box shapes, all 36 cells, all eight starting frames, every transition-length option, and Normal, Quad, and Second modes.

Cell labels use the project convention requested during development: left header first, then top header. The internal reference is included separately for code-level investigation.
